literal_meaning: পশুর খাদ্য বা যাত্রীদের খাবারের সরবরাহ
figurative_meaning_en: material; subject (as in fodder or basis for an activity, often ridicule)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই খবরটা গসিপের খোরাক হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has got me as fodder for laughter.
This news has become fodder for gossip.
note: Often used in phrases like 'কোনোকিছুর খোরাক' to denote material for an action, rooted in agrarian imagery of animal feed.
